description: Create an extension project from a template (extension_templates); it may init git. It is verified, so the next step is extension_dev, not a build; `scripts` name the outputs (`npm run build` writes dist/chromium). Sends one draft_seeded event; the readme's Telemetry section turns it off.

parentDir.description: Where to create it; default the MCP server process cwd. Aliases: parent, into.
